The mature East Asian Chinese man in his thirties (B, 33-38) stays seated, small in the frame. No dialogue at all; the whole beat is carried by her motion and the empty seat. Eye-level, DSLR 50mm, 16:9 horizontal framing, shallow depth of field kept mild so the room and the empty seat stay readable, subtle film grain, natural color.
